name: opencode-panel
description: A readable review panel for OpenCode sessions: streamed answers, syntax-highlighted snippets, and a type-it-yourself workflow.

chatSessions.name: opencode
chatSessions.description: Sessions from the local OpenCode server

commands.title: OpenCode: Open Existing Session in Panel
OpenCode: Import VS Code Chat into Panel
OpenCode: Backport Panel Session to VS Code Chat
OpenCode: Open Session in VS Code Chat

opencodePanel.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Override the OpenCode server URL (for example `http://127.0.0.1:4096`). Leave empty to auto-discover the local background service from its registration file.

opencodePanel.agent.markdownDescription: Optional agent ID to use for new sessions. Leave empty to use the server default.

opencodePanel.model.markdownDescription: Optional model to use for new sessions, as `provider/model` (for example `opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free`). Leave empty to use the server default.

opencodePanel.showReasoning.description: Show model reasoning (thinking) parts in the panel.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run package && code --install-extension ./opencode-panel.vsix --force && pnpm run enable-proposed-api
